title: possible issue with manipulate and missing settings wheel
description: The `mosaic::mplot()` function (https://github.com/ProjectMOSAIC/mosaic/blob/master/R/mPlots.R) allows students and instructors to visually explore a dataset (and output the syntax used to create a plot in ggformula or ggplot2). The function was written by Randy Pruim and is built on manipulate (which I see has been stable for a *long* time). Recently we have observed an issue where the settings wheel doesn't display at first when `mplot()` is called. See the following visual depictions. 1) Load packages and display session information 2) Run `mplot(mtcars)`: note no settings wheel displays 3) Run a simple command using `manipulate()`: note that the settings wheel now appears 4) Navigate back to the first manipulate plot: the settings wheel now appears I've been unable to find any examples of direct `manipulate()` calls that exhibit this issue so suspect that the problem is in `mplot()`. But that also hasn't changed recently which led me to post this issue.

title: Bug with file names in picker.
description:
If in name given to picker present two spaces then picker returns NULL on choice.
Example code resulting to error:

``` R
library("manipulate")

data<-1:10

write(data,file = paste0("good",paste0(rep(' ',1),collapse = ''),"name.data"))
write(data[10:1],file = paste0("bad",paste0(rep(' ',2),collapse = ''),"name.data"))

fList<-dir(pattern = "*.data")

manipulate(plot(scan(fName)),
           fName=picker(as.list(fList),initial=fList[1]))
```

Pick 'good name.data' and then again pick 'bad  name.data' results to error:
